title: ModuleTaskContractContextService
responsibility: Create a sealed per-task offline Harness CLI that serves selected-revision app contracts while the native worker lacks foreign source and Git access.

inputs.name: create.task
inputs.type: ModuleTask; committed sourceCommit and module assignment

inputs.name: create.files
inputs.type: trusted canonical role-specific relative file grants

outputs.name: create
outputs.description: {scope:TaskRunScope,binDirectory:string,cleanup():Promise<void>}; snapshot and executable CLI immutable, scratch separate, app-wide contracts metadata only. SourceCommit includes selected task revision; versions are forwarded committed records; binDirectory included in trusted scope. Restricted CLI may omit source/test resource fields explicitly. Private CLI launcher must use only trusted configuration; no task worktree Bun config/preloads before executing sealed CLI. Sealed executable is <binDirectory>/harness mode 0555; its absolute shebang uses canonical process.execPath. Bun uses an empty readonly <binDirectory>/bunfig.toml. scope.readPaths includes runtime and binDirectory; snapshot is separately sealed readonly. No special environment is required.

errors.name: missing or invalid committed metadata
errors.type: prelaunch rejection without source scanning or repair

errors.name: tampered context, unknown contract or forbidden command
Unknown assigned module
errors.description: Reject task.module.id absent from committed declarations; do not expose a context for an invalid assignment.
